of SC/ST Act, P.S. Kotwali Nagar, District Pratapgarh.

sentences.text: It is alleged in the first information report that minor daughter of the informant was lured in a love relationship by the accused and on 14.05.2022 at about 03:00 am he entered into the house of the informant and raped his daughter.
After alarm was raised, the villagers gathered and with the help of police, he was caught.
Learned counsel for applicant submits that a perusal of the statement of the victim under Sections 161 & 164 Cr.P.C. shows that she was a consenting party.
As per the prosecution case, applicant returned from Bombay to Pratapgarh and came to meet the victim at 02:00 am in the night at her house.
Since both of them were caught therefore, the F.I.R. was lodged.

He submits that perusal of the statement under Section 164 Cr.P.C. further shows that since the family members of the applicant are not willing to marry with the victim, therefore, the first information report has been lodged.
On the same day medical has been conducted in which no fresh injury or corroborative material or any sign of struggle has been found which again shows that she was a consenting party.
In the ossification test, age of the victim is found to be 17-18 years.
Victim is major.
The applicant is in jail since14.05.2022.
Learned A.G.A. has opposed the bail prayer.

On due consideration to the submissions advanced, perusal of the record as also the fact that the applicant is languishing in jail since 14.05.2022 having no criminal history, statement of victim recorded under Sections 161 & 164 Cr.P.C. and the prompt medical conducted of the victim prima facie case for bail is made out, without expressing any opinion on merits of the case, I find it to be a fit case for enlarging the applicant on bail.
Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

Let the applicant Rohit @ Sonu Modanwal be released on bail in aforesaid case crime number subject to his furnishing a personal bond and two reliable sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial court concerned with the following conditions:
(i) The applicant will not tamper with the evidence during the trial.
(ii) The applicant will not pressurize/ intimidate the prosecution witness.
(iii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iv) The applicant shall file an undertaking to the effect that he shall not seek any adjournment on the dates fixed for evidence when the witnesses are present in court.

In case of default of this condition, it shall be open for the trial court to treat it as abuse of liberty of bail and pass orders in accordance with law.

2 (v) The applicant shall remain present before the trial court on each date fixed, either personally or through his counsel.
